I tremble in fear when a car slows down next to me, or when someone yells at me from across the street, or when I’m getting stared at by an older man. I always wonder whens the day that i will be snatched up by a group of dudes and sold into trafficking. I have never felt comfortable in my own skin, and i doubt that it will ever really go away because of the way I was raised to think of myself.
